method.formula: kcal = MET × 3.5 × weightKg / 200 × minutes; active work and rest calculated separately
method.assumptions: Adult reference estimates. Repetitions take 2–4 seconds; rest 45–90 seconds between sets (60–120 for plyometrics). Rest uses 1.3 MET. Setup, warm-up and cool-down are excluded. Activity-class MET ranges are approximate, not exercise-specific measurements.
